metric_formula: Points won while serving / own total serves * 100
note: Point winner and serving team taken once per point_id.

metric_formula: (Reception # and +) / receptions * 100
note: Confirmed reception codes: # Perfect pass; + Positive, attack.

metric_formula: Reception grade - / receptions * 100
note: Uses only reception evaluation_code '-'; reception errors '=' are excluded.

metric_formula: (Kills - attack errors) / attacks
note: Kills=#; errors include '=' Error and '/' Blocked. '!' Blocked for reattack is not an error.

metric_formula: (First-ball kills - first-ball errors) / first-ball attacks
note: First-ball attack_phase == Reception; blocked '/' counted as attack error.

metric_formula: (Kills - errors off # or + reception) / attacks off # or + reception
note: Reception grade linked by point_id + team + team_touch_id.

metric_formula: (Kills - errors off ! reception) / attacks off ! reception
note: Reception grade linked by point_id + team + team_touch_id.

metric_formula: (Kills - errors off - reception) / attacks off - reception
note: Uses reception grade '-' only; grade linked by point_id + team + team_touch_id.

metric_formula: (Transition kills - transition errors) / transition attacks
note: Includes attack_phase values beginning with 'Transition'.

metric_formula: (Aces + opponent '-' receptions while this team serves) / own serves * 100
note: Aces use Serve #; poor passes use opponent Reception '-' and serving_team == this team.

metric_formula: (Aces + opponent '-' receptions while this team serves) / (own serves - own serve errors) * 100
note: Serve errors use Serve evaluation_code '='.

metric_formula: (Winning blocks # + positive block touches +) / opponent attacks * 100

metric_formula: Successful dig -> set -> kill sequences / total digs * 100
note: One successful sequence per point_id/team/team_touch_id, even if multiple digs occur.
